en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: W-what is it!? Are people flaming me in the comments!? Are they saying I’m not worthy of being a school idol at Hasunosora!?

『もう無理です走れません～』って音を上げたときには

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
To be honest, on your first day, when you gave up before even reaching five hundred meters,
saying, "I can't anymore, I can't run,"

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
솔직히, 첫날 네가 500미터도 못 가서
'더는 무리예요 못 달려요~' 하고 포기했을 때는

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: If I’m being honest, on that first day of exercising together, when you couldn’t even run 500 meters with me, and you gave up and told me that you couldn’t run anymore…

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 花帆汎用2_両手を下の方で広げる

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 花帆汎用2_両手を下の方で広げる

turns.textJp:
ちゃんと最後までがんばり通してくれるとは、
思いも寄らなかったわ。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text:
I never imagined
that you would keep doing your best all the way to the end.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text:
제대로 끝까지 열심히 해낼 거라고는,
생각도 못 했어.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: I didn’t expect you’d actually make it this far.

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 花帆汎用2_両手を下の方で広げる

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 花帆汎用2_両手を下の方で広げる

turns.textJp:
あはは……。あたしもです。
っていうかあたし……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
Ahaha... Me neither.
I mean, I...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
아하하……. 저도요.
아니, 저…….

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Ahaha… Me too. Actually…

turns.textJp:
自分がこんなにちゃんと努力できるなんて、知りませんでした。
受験のときも、確かにがんばってはいたんですけど……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
I didn't know I could make this much effort properly.
I did work hard when I was studying for entrance exams, but...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
제가 이렇게 제대로 노력할 수 있을 줄은, 몰랐어요.
입시 때도, 분명 열심히 하긴 했지만…….

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: I didn’t think I could ever work this hard. Although I did study really hard for those entrance exams…

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 花帆汎用2_両手を下の方で広げる

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 花帆汎用2_両手を下の方で広げる

turns.textJp:
あのときは結局、
なんだかんだ理由をつけてサボったりしちゃってましたし……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
Back then, in the end,
I kept making excuses and slacking off...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
그때는 결국,
이런저런 이유를 대면서 땡땡이치기도 했고…….

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Back then, I would take any excuse I could get to not have to work so hard.

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 腕を掴んでうつむく（正面）

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 腕を掴んでうつむく（正面）

turns.textJp: それは、厳しい先輩がいなかったからね。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text: That was because you did not have a strict senpai.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text: 그건, 엄격한 선배가 없었기 때문이지.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: That’s because you didn’t have a strict mentor like me around.

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 腕を掴んでうつむく（正面）

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 腕を掴んでうつむく（正面）

turns.textJp: そうですね！

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: That's true!

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 그렇네요!

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Yeah!

turns.textJp: あはは。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho & Kozue
en_hasuko.text: Ahaha.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호&코즈에
ko_hasuko.text: 아하하.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho & Kozue
en_idolst.text: Ahaha.

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 花帆汎用2_両手を下の方で広げる

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 花帆汎用2_両手を下の方で広げる

turns.textJp:
……ちょーっと、あたしのこと、
話してもいいですか？

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
...Can I talk
a little bit about myself?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
……잠깐, 제 이야기,
해도 괜찮을까요?

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: …Could I say something a little personal?

turns.textJp: ええ、聞きたいわ。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text: Yes, I would like to hear.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text: 응, 듣고 싶어.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: Go ahead. I’d love to hear it.

turns.textJp:
あたしのおうち、けっこう過保護なんですけど……
それって、元はというとあたしの責任だったりして。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
My family is pretty overprotective...
and that was originally kind of my fault.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
저희 집, 꽤 과보호인데……
그건, 원래는 제 책임이기도 해서요.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: My family was always pretty overprotective, but…maybe it was my fault they were like that.

turns.textJp: あなたの？

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text: Yours?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text: 너의?

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: Why so?

turns.textJp:
ねえ、お母さん。
きょうはお外に遊びに行ってもいい……？

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
Hey, Mom.
Can I go play outside today...?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
엄마.
오늘 밖에 나가서 놀아도 돼……?

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Hey, Mom… Could I play outside today…?

turns.textJp:
まだ、だーめ。
お熱、下がっていないでしょ？

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho's Mother
en_hasuko.text:
Not yet.
Your fever hasn't gone down, has it?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호 엄마
ko_hasuko.text:
아직, 안~돼.
열, 안 내렸잖아?

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho's Mother
en_idolst.text: No, not yet. You’re still running a fever, aren’t you?

turns.textJp: うん……。ケホッ、ケホッ！

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: Yeah... Cough, cough!

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 응……. 콜록, 콜록!

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Yeah… Cough, cough!

turns.textJp:
子供の頃、ちょっと体が弱くて……。
何度か、入院したこともあったんです。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
When I was little, I was a little frail...
I was even hospitalized a few times.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
어렸을 때, 몸이 좀 약해서…….
몇 번, 입원한 적도 있었어요.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: When I was really young, I was pretty frail… I was actually hospitalized a couple of times.

turns.textJp: あ、中学校にあがったくらいからはぜんぜん大丈夫になったんですけど！

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: Oh, but after I started middle school, I became completely fine!

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 아, 중학교 올라갈 때쯤부터는 전혀 괜찮아졌지만요!

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Oh, but I was better by the time I went to middle school!

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 花帆汎用2_両手を下の方で広げる

turns.textJp:
大丈夫になったんですけど……
お父さんとお母さんにとっては、あたしは小さな頃のまんまみたいで。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
I did become fine...
but to my mom and dad, I guess I was still the same as when I was little.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
괜찮아졌지만……
아빠랑 엄마한테는, 저는 어렸을 때 그대로인 것 같아서.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: I was better, but… To my parents, I was still that same little girl.

turns.textJp:
あたしはあれもやりたい、これもやりたいって思ってても、
結局できなくって。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
Even if I wanted to do this and that,
in the end I couldn't.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
저는 이것도 하고 싶다, 저것도 하고 싶다 생각해도,
결국 못 하고.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: I always wanted to try new things, but I would never be able to do it.

turns.textJp:
無茶してまた熱出したりしたら、
両親が心配しちゃうからって。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
Because if I overdid it and got a fever again,
my parents would worry.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
무리해서 또 열이라도 나면,
부모님이 걱정하시니까.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: My parents would always worry that I would get sick again.

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 手をお腹の前で合わせる

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 手をお腹の前で合わせる

turns.textJp: そうだったの。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text: I see.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text: 그랬구나.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: I see.

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 手をお腹の前で合わせる

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 手をお腹の前で合わせる

turns.textJp:
うち、お花を作ってるんです。
ラナンキュラスって言うんですけど、すっごくきれいなんですよ。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
My family grows flowers.
They're called ranunculus, and they're really beautiful.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
저희 집, 꽃을 키워요.
라넌큘러스라고 하는데, 엄청 예뻐요.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Back home, we had a flower garden. The buttercups that grew from there were always so pretty.

turns.textJp:
春になると、パステルカラーみたいな淡い色合いが、
ばーっと咲き誇って！

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
When spring comes, pale colors like pastels
bloom all at once!

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
봄이 되면, 파스텔 톤 같은 옅은 색깔이,
쫙 피어나요!

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Every spring, they would always blossom into these really light pastel colors!

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 花帆汎用2_両手を下の方で広げる

turns.textJp:
あたしの花帆って名前も、
そのお花からイメージしてつけてくれたんです。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
My name, Kaho,
was inspired by those flowers.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
제 이름 카호도,
그 꽃에서 이미지를 따서 지어주셨어요.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: My name, Kaho, came from the image of those flowers.

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 花帆汎用2_両手を下の方で広げる

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 花帆汎用2_両手を下の方で広げる

turns.textJp:
窓から眺めるお花が、とってもきれいで……。
だけど、昔のあたしは、その景色があんまり好きじゃなくって。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
The flowers I saw from the window were so beautiful...
But back then, I didn't really like that scenery.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
창문으로 바라보는 꽃이, 정말 예뻐서…….
하지만, 옛날의 저는, 그 풍경을 별로 좋아하지 않았어요.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: I would look out from the window and see those really pretty flowers… But back then, I hated seeing them.

turns.textJp: ……それは、どうして？

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text: ...Why was that?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text: ……그건, 왜?

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: …And why is that?

intraEvents.description: 頬に人差し指をあてて考える

梢.name: 梢
梢.motionDescription: 頬に人差し指をあてて考える

turns.textJp: 育てられたお花って規則正しく咲いているじゃないですか。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: Cultivated flowers bloom so neatly, don't they?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 길러진 꽃은 규칙적으로 피잖아요.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: If you properly care for flowers, they’ll always blossom, right?

turns.textJp:
でも、あたしって病気がちだったから、
学校でも遊びに入れてもらえないことがあって……。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
But because I was always getting sick,
there were times I couldn't join in at school or while playing...

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
근데, 저는 병치레가 잦아서,
학교에서도 같이 놀지 못할 때가 있어서…….

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: But I was always frail and sickly, so I couldn’t even have fun and play at school…

turns.textJp: 自分は、あんな風にキレイには咲けないような気がしていたんです。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: I felt like I could never bloom beautifully like that.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 저는, 저렇게 예쁘게는 필 수 없을 것 같다는 생각이 들었어요.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: I wished I could blossom as beautifully as those flowers.

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 手をグーにしてうつむく

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 手をグーにしてうつむく

turns.textJp:
自分の名前も……なんか、ちゃんと正しく育つように、
って期待されているみたいで。ちょっとニガテでした。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
Even my own name... felt like people expected me
to grow up properly and correctly. I wasn't very good with it.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
제 이름도…… 뭔가, 제대로 바르게 자라라고,
기대받는 것 같아서. 좀 싫었어요.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: I thought that… if I was properly cared for, I’d also blossom like the flower in my name. But that wasn’t how it turned out.

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 手をお腹の前で合わせる

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 手をお腹の前で合わせる

turns.textJp: そんなあなたが、変わったきっかけがあったのね。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kozue
en_hasuko.text: But something made you change, did it not?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 코즈에
ko_hasuko.text: 그런 네가, 변하게 된 계기가 있었구나.

en_idolst.speaker: Kozue
en_idolst.text: But then something changed.

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 手をお腹の前で合わせる

花帆.name: 花帆
花帆.motionDescription: 手をお腹の前で合わせる

turns.textJp: はい！

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: Yes!

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 네!

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Yeah!

turns.textJp:
ねえねえ、お姉ちゃんお姉ちゃん！
ちょっとお散歩しようよ！

en_hasuko.speaker: Minori
en_hasuko.text:
Hey, hey, big sis, big sis!
Let's go for a little walk!

ko_hasuko.speaker: 미노리
ko_hasuko.text:
언니, 언니!
잠깐 산책하자!

en_idolst.speaker: Minori
en_idolst.text: Hey, Sis, Sis! Come walk with us!

turns.textJp:
えー。
どうしたの、急に。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
Eeh.
What's this all of a sudden?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
에이.
왜 그래, 갑자기.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Huh? Why now?

turns.textJp: ね、ちょっとそこまでだから、お姉ちゃん。

en_hasuko.speaker: Futaba
en_hasuko.text: Come on, it's just a little way, big sis.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 후타바
ko_hasuko.text: 응, 잠깐 저기까지니까, 언니.

en_idolst.speaker: Futaba
en_idolst.text: Come on. It’ll just be a little walk.

turns.textJp: もう、ふたばまで。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: Honestly, even you, Futaba?

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 정말, 후타바까지.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Not you too, Futaba…

turns.textJp:
勝手に山に入ったーって、
怒られても知らないんだからね。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text:
If we get scolded for going into the mountains on our own,
don't blame me.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text:
마음대로 산에 들어갔다고,
혼나도 난 모른다.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
en_idolst.text: Mom and Dad will probably get mad at us for going into the mountains without permission.

turns.textJp: あとちょっと。

en_hasuko.speaker: Futaba
en_hasuko.text: Just a little farther.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 후타바
ko_hasuko.text: 조금만 더.

en_idolst.speaker: Futaba
en_idolst.text: Just a little more.

turns.textJp: ねえねえ、早く早く！

en_hasuko.speaker: Minori
en_hasuko.text: Hey, hey, hurry, hurry!

ko_hasuko.speaker: 미노리
ko_hasuko.text: 언니, 빨리빨리!

en_idolst.speaker: Minori
en_idolst.text: Hurry, hurry!

turns.textJp: なに、もー。

en_hasuko.speaker: Kaho
en_hasuko.text: What is it, geez.

ko_hasuko.speaker: 카호
ko_hasuko.text: 뭐야, 정말.

en_idolst.speaker: Kaho
